title_en: Opinion of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, the Supreme People's Court, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Justice, the Ministry of Finance, the All-China Federation of Trade Unions, the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce, and the China Enterprise Confederation/China Enterprise Directors Association on Further Strengthening the Work of Consultation and Mediation of Labor and Personnel Disputes
keywords_en: On further strengthening labor and personnel disputes
full_text_en:
Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, Supreme People's Court

Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Justice, Ministry of Finance, All-China Federation of Trade Unions

All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce, China Enterprise Confederation/China Enterprise Directors Association

Opinions on Further Strengthening the Work of Consultation and Mediation of Labor and Personnel Disputes

Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security Document No. (2022) 71

Labor and personnel dispute consultation and mediation is an important component of the comprehensive mechanism for diversified prevention, mediation, and resolution of social conflicts and disputes. Resolving labor and personnel disputes through flexible methods such as consultation and mediation is of great significance for preventing and defusing labor relations risks, protecting the legitimate rights and interests of workers, building harmonious labor relations, and maintaining social stability. In order to thoroughly implement the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, and implement the important decisions and deployments of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on "preventing and defusing major risks" and "persisting in putting non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms at the forefront", and to further strengthen the source governance of labor and personnel disputes, the following opinions are hereby put forward concerning strengthening the work of consultation and mediation of labor and personnel disputes:

I. General Requirements

(1) Guiding Ideology. Guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, deeply implementing Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, adhering to a systematic approach, goal orientation, and problem orientation, we will focus on strengthening risk prevention and control, strengthening source governance, improving diversified handling mechanisms, enhancing consultation and mediation capabilities, and promoting high-quality development of harmonious labor relations with Chinese characteristics.

(2) Basic Principles

1. Adhere to putting the people first, and integrate the concept of serving the people throughout the entire process of consultation and mediation work, expand service areas, optimize service methods, improve service capabilities, and create a high-quality brand of consultation and mediation services.

2. Adhere to source governance, give full play to the front-end and fundamental role of consultation and mediation, move the threshold forward, sink the center of gravity, and resolve labor and personnel disputes at the grassroots level and in the bud to the greatest extent possible.

3. Adhere to innovative development, respect the pioneering spirit at the grassroots level, actively explore new concepts, new mechanisms, and new measures, promote the integration of various types of mediation, promote social coordination and co-governance, and form a consultation and mediation work pattern that embodies Chinese characteristics, conforms to the laws of diversified handling of labor and personnel disputes, and meets the needs of the times.

4. Adhere to flexibility and efficiency, give full play to the advantages of flexibility, efficiency and convenience of consultation and mediation, use rule-of-law thinking and rule-of-law methods, promote the settlement of cases, the harmony of people, and promote harmonious labor relations and social stability.

(3) Objectives and Tasks. Starting from October 2022, we will continue to strengthen the construction of consultation and mediation systems, mechanisms and capabilities, and strive to basically achieve, within about 5 years, further improvement of organizational structures, further strengthening of team building, further improvement of systems, and further consolidation of basic guarantees; the diversified handling mechanism for labor and personnel disputes under the leadership of the Party committee, government responsibility, leadership of the human resources and social security department, participation of relevant departments, judicial guarantee, and scientific and technological support will be more complete; the quality and efficiency of departmental linkage will be significantly improved; the proportion of labor and personnel dispute cases resolved through consultation and mediation in the total number of cases will be significantly increased; labor and personnel dispute litigation cases will steadily decrease to a reasonable range; and the standardization, standardization, specialization, and intelligence level of consultation and mediation work will be significantly improved.

II. Strengthening Source Governance

(4) Strengthen prevention and guidance of labor and personnel disputes. Give full play to the important role of grassroots Party organizations in employing units in labor relations governance and consultation and mediation work, and lead the harmonious development of labor relations with Party building. Improve democratic management systems to ensure workers' rights to know, participate, express, and supervise major decisions and major matters of employing units. Implement systems such as publishing typical cases, union labor law supervision reminder letters and opinion letters, mediation suggestion letters, arbitration suggestion letters, judicial suggestion letters, and credit commitment letters, to guide employing units to comply with laws and regulations in employment and workers to express demands rationally in accordance with the law. Leverage the role of small and medium-sized enterprise service institutions to promote small and medium-sized enterprises to improve labor management systems and strengthen the prevention of labor and personnel disputes through training, consultation and other services. Service institutions with corresponding qualifications may undertake trustee services for labor relations affairs. Take the establishment of labor and personnel dispute mediation organizations by employing units and their work on consultation and mediation as an important consideration for evaluation, commendation, and demonstration creation such as the creation of harmonious labor relations. Give play to the functions of lawyers and legal advisors, promote the governance of enterprises according to law, strengthen compliance management in the field of labor and employment, and reduce labor and personnel disputes.

(5) Improve the monitoring and early warning mechanism for labor and personnel dispute risks. Establish and improve a monitoring mechanism for labor and personnel dispute risks, using changes in important indicators reflecting the operation of labor relations such as tax payment, social insurance arrears, case acceptance, complaints and reports, petition handling, and social public opinion to accurately assess the situation of labor and personnel disputes. Improve the early warning mechanism for major labor and personnel dispute risks, focusing on important time nodes, highlighting key groups such as migrant workers, labor dispatch, and workers in new forms of employment, focusing on major types of labor and personnel disputes such as confirmation of labor relations, recovery of labor remuneration, working hours, termination and rescission of labor contracts, strengthen monitoring and early warning, establish risk ledgers, and formulate response plans.

(6) Strengthen the investigation and resolution of hidden dangers in labor and personnel disputes. Establish a contact point system for key areas, key industries, and key enterprises, focusing on industrial parks and industries such as the Internet, construction, labor-intensive processing and manufacturing, as well as enterprises whose production and operation are difficult due to major changes in objective economic conditions or emergencies, carry out comprehensive investigations, promptly identify nascent and trending problems, and properly resolve risks and hidden dangers caused by wage arrears, irregular employment, etc. Strengthen coordinated governance of hidden dangers in labor and personnel disputes, improve information sharing and coordinated linkage between mediation and arbitration institutions, labor relations and labor security supervision institutions, and union labor law supervision organizations, jointly strengthen guidance on labor and employment, and fulfill the preventive function of "grasping the front end and treating diseases before they occur".

III. Strengthening Consultation and Reconciliation

(7) Guide the establishment of internal labor and personnel dispute consultation mechanisms. Cultivate the awareness of consultation on labor and personnel disputes among employing units and workers, and promote employing units to establish and improve communication and dialogue mechanisms and smooth channels for workers to express demands by setting up responsible person reception days, holding labor-management consultations, opening hotlines or email addresses, setting up suggestion boxes, forming online communication groups, etc. Guide employing units to improve internal complaint and consultation response systems, optimize labor and personnel dispute consultation procedures, carefully study and formulate solutions, and timely respond to workers' consultation demands.

(8) Assist in carrying out labor and personnel dispute consultation. Trade union organizations coordinate resources such as labor legal supervision committees, collective negotiation指导员 and legal aid volunteer teams, promote the improvement of workers' appeal channels and dispute consultation platforms, help workers and employing units conduct labor and personnel dispute consultations, and do a good job in consultation and answering questions, legal interpretation and reasoning, persuasion and guidance, and promoting reconciliation. Local trade unions at all levels may set up labor and personnel dispute consultation rooms to do a good job in labor and personnel dispute consultation. Enterprise representative organizations guide enterprises to strengthen their consultation capacity and improve internal labor dispute consultation procedures. Encourage and support social forces to carry out consultation, agency, and legal aid services for labor and personnel disputes.

(9) Strengthen the performance and effectiveness of reconciliation agreements. When workers and employing units reach an agreement on labor and personnel disputes through consultation, trade union organizations should actively guide the signing of reconciliation agreements and promote the performance of reconciliation agreements. If the worker or employing unit fails to perform the reconciliation agreement on time, the trade union organization should actively do a good job in guiding the application for mediation, etc. After review by the labor and personnel dispute arbitration commission, if the procedures and content of the reconciliation agreement are legal and valid, it may be used as evidence in arbitration proceedings; however, facts conceded by the worker or employing unit for the purpose of reaching a reconciliation shall not be used as evidence against them in subsequent arbitration or litigation, except as otherwise provided by law or as agreed by both the worker and the employing unit.

IV. Strengthening Diversified Mediation

(10) Promote the construction of grassroots labor and personnel dispute mediation organizations. The human resources and social security department, together with the judicial administration department, trade unions, enterprise representative organizations, enterprises and institutions, and social organizations, shall promote employing units to strengthen the construction of mediation organizations. Promote the widespread establishment of labor dispute mediation committees in large and medium-sized enterprises, and establish and improve labor dispute consultation and mediation mechanisms for small and micro enterprises, supported by mediation organizations at the township (street), trade union, industry association (chamber of commerce), and regional levels, with mediators (information officers) as the contact points. Promote the strengthening of mediation organization construction in institutions and social organizations, and standardize labor and personnel management and employment behavior.

(11) Build mediation centers of municipal and county-level labor and personnel dispute arbitration institutions and trade union legal service workstations. Promote the establishment of labor and personnel dispute mediation centers (hereinafter referred to as mediation centers) within municipal and county-level labor and personnel dispute arbitration institutions (hereinafter referred to as arbitration institutions) where conditions permit, and provide labor and personnel dispute mediation services by allocating staff or purchasing services. The mediation center is responsible for handling cases assigned or entrusted by the arbitration institution and the people's court, and assists the human resources and social security department in guiding the work of mediation organizations at the township (street), trade union, industry association (chamber of commerce), and regional levels within its jurisdiction. Explore and promote trade union organizations to set up trade union legal service workstations in arbitration institutions and people's courts where labor and personnel dispute cases are numerous and workers' demands are concentrated. Where conditions permit, local trade unions may arrange for dedicated personnel to carry out dispute consultation, mediation, and legal services, and establish a normalized mechanism for connecting mediation with arbitration and litigation.

(12) Strengthen the standardization of mediation work. The human resources and social security department, together with the judicial administration department, trade unions, enterprise representative organizations and other departments, shall implement the system of mediation organization and mediator rosters, guide various types of labor and personnel dispute mediation organizations to establish and improve systems such as mediation acceptance registration, mediation handling, notification and guidance, feedback on return visits, file management, and statistical reporting, and improve the standardization level of mediation work. Increase the intensity of supervision over the performance of mediation agreements, strengthen the assessment of the parties' ability to perform, and issue a performance notice to the parties after reaching a mediation agreement. Summarize and promote mature experiences and characteristic practices formed by mediation organizations in practice, and give play to the leading role of typical examples.

(13) Give play to the characteristic advantages of various types of mediation organizations. Enterprise labor dispute mediation committees should give play to their advantages of being familiar with internal operating rules and workers' conditions, and guide the parties to prioritize resolving labor disputes through mediation. People's mediation organizations should give play to their advantages of being rooted at the grassroots, close to the masses, and familiar with social conditions and public opinion, and increase efforts in handling labor and personnel disputes. Township (street) labor and personnel dispute mediation organizations should give play to their professional advantages, actively promote standardization, standardization, and intelligent construction, and help employing units within their jurisdiction to prevent and resolve labor and personnel disputes. Industry and regional labor and personnel dispute mediation organizations should give play to their advantages of having industry influence and regional driving force, and help enterprises cultivate mediation personnel and carry out mediation work. Commerce (association) mediation organizations should give play to their advantages of being close to enterprises, actively resolve labor disputes, and cooperate in social governance. The human resources and social security department, the judicial administration department, trade unions, and enterprise representative organizations guide and regulate willing social organizations, lawyers, experts and scholars, and other social forces to actively and orderly participate in mediation work, further increasing the supply of mediation services.

V. Improving the Joint Work System

(14) Improve the joint work system connecting labor and personnel dispute mediation with people's mediation, administrative mediation, and judicial mediation. Under the overall coordination of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the Party Committee, the human resources and social security department shall strengthen work communication with judicial administration, courts, trade unions, enterprise representative organizations and other departments, forming a work pattern of joint conflict mediation, joint force linkage, and information connectivity, and establishing and improving an emergency joint handling mechanism for major labor and personnel disputes. In areas with conditions, a "one-window" mechanism for accepting and transferring labor and personnel disputes may be established, and various online mediation platforms may be connected, a physical joint mediation center may be established, and other ways to strengthen the integration of various mediation resources. A sharing mechanism for mediators and expert databases may be established based on actual conditions to flexibly deploy personnel and improve the professionalism of case handling.

(15) Participate in the construction of social conflict and dispute mediation centers. All relevant departments shall actively integrate into the comprehensive mechanism for diversified prevention, mediation, and resolution of social conflicts and disputes led by the local Party committee and government, give play to their functional advantages, dispatch mediation and arbitration staff to social conflict and dispute mediation centers, handle labor and personnel dispute cases, participate in joint resolution, provide business support, and do a good job in guaranteeing personnel, funds, venues, equipment, etc.

(16) Strengthen the connection between mediation and arbitration and litigation. Improve the connection between mediation and arbitration, and establish a system of arbitrators contacting mediation organizations by region. When both parties reach an agreement through mediation, the mediation organization shall guide the parties to apply for arbitration review or judicial confirmation, and timely consolidate the mediation results. Arbitration institutions, through recommending mediation, entrusting mediation, and other means, actively guide parties who have not undergone mediation to the mediation organization for pre-mediation. Strengthen the connection between mediation and litigation. For disputes suitable for mediation, such as recovery of labor remuneration and economic compensation, resolve them first through pre-litigation mediation and other non-litigation methods. Promote the "total-to-total" online litigation and mediation connection for labor and personnel disputes, and carry out the entire process of online assignment and entrustment of mediation, audio and video mediation, and application for judicial confirmation of mediation agreements. Establish a provincial-level expert database for labor and personnel dispute mediation, and include qualified mediation organizations and personnel in the special invitation mediation roster to participate in mediating and resolving major, difficult, and complex labor and personnel disputes. Implement the payment order system in accordance with the law.

VI. Improving Service Capabilities

(17) Strengthen the construction of the mediator team. Enhance the consultation and mediation capacity of labor and personnel disputes through government purchase of services and other means. Expand the sources of part-time mediators, widely absorb legal experts, arbitrators, lawyers, labor relations coordinators (professionals), retired judges, retired prosecutors and other professional forces to participate in mediation. Strengthen training and guidance for mediators, develop national vocational skill standards, effectively improve the professional ethics of mediators, enhance service awareness, and improve case handling capabilities.

(18) Strengthen the construction of smart consultation and mediation. Promote the deep integration of information technology with consultation and mediation, establish an inter-departmental data and information sharing mechanism, integrate and use various types of big data to conduct analysis and research on labor and personnel dispute situations. Improve the mediation functions of online platforms, mobile phone apps, WeChat mini-programs, WeChat public accounts, and other platforms, promote "online handling" and "handheld handling", and realize the continuous advancement of consultation and mediation towards intelligence.

(19) Guarantee work funds. The human resources and social security department shall include consultation and mediation in the guiding catalog of government purchase of services. Local financial departments shall, in light of local actual conditions and financial capacity, reasonably arrange funds, provide necessary support and guarantee for consultation and mediation work funds, strengthen hardware support, and provide necessary office and case handling facilities and equipment for mediation organizations.

(20) Implement work responsibilities. Building harmonious labor relations is an inevitable requirement for strengthening the Party's ruling foundation and consolidating the Party's ruling position, an important part of strengthening and innovating social governance and ensuring and improving people's livelihood, and an important foundation for promoting high-quality economic development and social harmony and stability. All localities must regard doing a good job in consultation and mediation as an important task in building harmonious labor relations, earnestly enhance their sense of responsibility, mission, and urgency, actively seek support from the Party committee and government, include this work in the local overall planning for economic and social development and the government target responsibility assessment system, and promote solid and effective development of the work. Party committees' political and legal affairs commissions at all levels should include the construction of the diversified handling mechanism for labor and personnel disputes in the peace construction assessment, and promote relevant departments to refine evaluation standards and improve supervision and inspection, evaluation and promotion work. The human resources and social security department should play a leading role in the diversified handling of labor and personnel disputes, work with relevant departments to coordinate and promote the construction of mediation organizations, systems and teams, and improve the evaluation mechanism for mediation effectiveness. The people's courts should play a role in judicial guidance, promotion and guarantee, and strengthen the organic connection between mediation and litigation. The judicial administration department should guide mediation organizations to actively carry out labor and personnel dispute mediation work, strengthen training on labor law and policy knowledge for mediators, and encourage and guide lawyers to participate in legal aid and socialized mediation. The financial department should ensure consultation and mediation work funds, urge relevant departments to strengthen fund management, and maximize the effectiveness of fund use. The competent department of small and medium-sized enterprises should further improve the service system, guide small and medium-sized enterprise service institutions to help enterprises comply with laws and regulations in employment, reduce employment risks, and build harmonious labor relations. Trade unions should actively participate in the diversified resolution of labor and personnel disputes, guide workers to express their interests and demands rationally in accordance with the law, help workers negotiate and resolve labor and personnel disputes, provide legal services to workers in accordance with the law, effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of workers, and sincerely serve workers. The Federation of Industry and Commerce, the China Enterprise Confederation, etc., should play a representative role, guide and support enterprises to operate in good faith and lawfully, fulfill social responsibilities, and establish and improve internal labor and personnel dispute resolution mechanisms.

Provincial human resources and social security departments at all levels shall, together with relevant departments, formulate practical implementation plans in accordance with the spirit of this opinion, clarify tasks, measures, responsibilities, and requirements, regularly supervise and inspect the implementation of this opinion, and promptly report the progress of the work to the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security.

October 13, 2022
